name: uldaman
notes: Uldaman (map 70) from the main entrance (areatrigger 286) to Archaedas, the last boss. Legs 0-3 (Baelog, Revelosh, Keystone, Ironaya) are the west wing and were run remotely end to end (remote run 5); legs 4-13 go on from Ironaya's room and were written from the world database of tortoise-wow 5d79486 (map 70 creature and game object spawns, templates, EventAI, the C++ scripts of src/scripts/dungeons/uldaman) and the map 70 navmesh, then compared with the live map walk of 2026-10-14 (a GM walker, nothing fought or used). They have NOT been run as a party: Obsidian Sentinel, Ancient Stone Keeper, Galgann, Grimlok, the Altar of the Keepers with its four Stone Keepers, Archaedas. Order of legs 0-3 follows docs/guides/dungeon-tactics.md section 8 of TortoiseBots (PR 859).

Honest (non-GM) run: the baelog leg pulls its packs and loots Baelog's Chest; revelosh kills Revelosh, loots the Shaft of Tsol and makes the Staff of Prehistoria; keystone opens the Keystone with it. A Horde leader kills Baelog, Eric and Olaf (team: horde); for an Alliance leader the boss is skipped unless the lost dwarves show up hostile in the feed (remote run 2: they were hostile to an Alliance party and joined the pull of the last pack), then it is fought like a pull group. Pass criteria: docs/LIVE-CHECKS.md.

Baelog and Revelosh stand in side rooms: the navmesh route from the entrance to the Keystone leaves the Baelog branch at -250 135 and passes 23 yd from Revelosh. A run that wants the shortest way starts at the leg 'keystone'.

Packs are the spawns of the world database within 8 yd of the route, grouped by tools/dungeongen (12 yd, creature groups). Doors are not on the navmesh: path_to walks through a closed door, so the door steps are not checked by it.

Quests: none is needed for this plan. The Alliance chain around it is 'The Lost Dwarves' (2398, from Prospector Stormpike, 1356, in the Hall of Explorers, Ironforge; ends at Baelog in Uldaman) then 'The Hidden Chamber' (2240, from Baelog, 6906; read Baelog's Journal, explore the Chamber of Khaz'mul behind the Keystone door, report to Stormpike). Neither gates the Medallion (gameobject_loot_template 5066/7740, 100%, no condition) or the Shaft (creature_loot_template 6910/7741, 100%, no condition), world database of tortoise-wow 5d79486.

Remote run entry: entrance_tele is game_tele 169 ("ulda", map 70, next to the entrance); portal is the centre of areatrigger 286 on map 0 (areatrigger_template, radius 10), where a non-GM remote run walks the lead bot in. Both are for the enter phase only (docs/LIVE-CHECKS.md).

Order of legs 4-13. The TortoiseBots guide lists the Altar of the Keepers between the Sentinel and the Ancient Stone Keeper; on the navmesh the Hall of the Keepers lies past Grimlok and the Ancient Stone Keeper is a dead-end side room, so the legs follow the route: scorpid cave (and the hole in the mesh), Sentinel, Ancient Stone Keeper, Galgann, Grimlok, Keepers, Archaedas. Grimlok is the 7th boss of the dungeon, as the guide says. Ironaya's room is a dead end: the way on goes back south and east through the cave to the pit with the Cleft Scorpid nest (the live map walk found this; the first draft assumed an exit north of the room). Walk lengths on the navmesh: see README, The Uldaman plan.

The Hall of the Keepers and the Vault: two levels (z -26.5 and z -52) joined only by the ramp behind the Temple Door 124367. The doors: 124368 (hall entrance) and 141869 (Archaedas) are plain doors spawned closed with no script and lock 86; 124370 (Echomok) is one too but off the route; 124367 and 124369 (faction 114, lock 85) are opened by the instance script (all four Stone Keepers dead; Archaedas dead), 124372 by the Keystone's script. The navmesh has no doors and `walk_path` goes through closed ones, so a door step comes before the walk through it. Lock.dbc is not in the export: whether lock 86 asks for anything is unverified, and the first live run settles it.

Both altars are summoning rituals of three participants (see the notes of keepers_altar and archaedas): the plan's ritual step has three bots use the altar (remote runs; the group driver cannot take that step yet) and its final answer is the result: the altar reads ready again once the bots are let go, so nothing waits for it to be active.

Turtle 1.18.1 additions found in the map 70 data: the Ancient Treasure Chest (2010828, behind the Vault) and the quest 'Rebuilding the Relic' (41733; item 41800 drops from the Stone Keepers at -100 % for it). Nothing found changes how a boss fights: the instance, Ironaya, Archaedas and minion scripts are the ScriptDev2 C++ ones in src/scripts/dungeons/uldaman, the Sentinel, Galgann, Grimlok and Stone Keepers run EventAI rows. The live map walk found no difference from the SQL in the visited area. No quest or item gates any of legs 4-13 (the Staff is only for the Keystone).

Dormant statues: the Stone Keepers, the Vault's Earthen Custodians, Guardians and Hallshapers and the four Vault Warders are faction 35 in the SQL but read as hostile in the agent's unit rows (live map walk). If the TBM feed lists them as hostile too, the driver may see them as targets before they are woken: the Archaedas leg lists them in skip, the Keepers group is pulled only after the altar step.

Written by hand from the dungeongen skeleton (tools/dungeongen/testdata/uldaman); positions checked against the server's navmesh by internal/dungeon TestUldamanOnNavmesh. Checked against the hires-1 trace (live run of 2026-10-14, 5 hires): all 23 `cmd move` refusals `unreachable` (no walkable path) were moves of the lead bot to its own position after a fight (holdHere; the server cannot path to where a bot already stands), not plan points, and every one of those spots is on this navmesh; every plan point and pullback anchor has navmesh floor within 1 yd on the ground and 3 yd vertically (TestUldamanPlanPointsOnMesh), so no point was moved. The one real hole is the scorpid pit (leg 5). Legs 4-13: the pull groups are the spawns of the export within 10 yd of the navmesh route from the previous leg's end to the leg's boss (the Keepers' hall: 31 yd), grouped as dungeongen groups them and put in the order of the route; the Galgann room's two caster pairs and the Grimlok corridor's pair at 38 439 are added by hand (8-12 yd off the route).

legs.name: baelog
notes: Baelog, Eric 'The Swift' (6907) and Olaf (6908) are the Lost Dwarves: faction 122 (the Ironforge dwarves), npc_flags 2 (questgiver), no script that turns them hostile (world database, Lane C investigation 2026-10-13). The world database says they are friendly to the Alliance, but live (remote Uldaman run 2, 2026-10-14) they were HOSTILE to an Alliance party: the pull of the pack at -332 101 (4852 x2) aggroed all three and the party killed them. So the 'team': 'horde' on the boss is only the default when nothing says otherwise: the Stepper skips it for an Alliance leader only if none of 6906-6908 is hostile in the feed (listed alive now, or seen alive earlier in the run and not killed since), and fights it like a pull group (Eric and Olaf first, Baelog last) when they are (remote driver; group mode keeps the plan's gate as written). TortoiseBots PR 859 says Eric and Olaf die with Baelog, but the world database has no script for it (no creature_linking row; their creature_ai events only cast Rushing Charge and Shield Slam, Baelog flees at 15% health).

Baelog's Chest (game object 123329, a chest, lock 93, loot 5066: the Gni'kiv Medallion, item 7740, 100%) stands 3-4 yd from Baelog. Anyone may open it, no kill needed, so the last step of the leg, after the boss, is loot_object: the leader casts the Opening spell at it (use_object on a chest does nothing in this core) and takes the Medallion, which the Revelosh leg combines with the Shaft of Tsol into the Staff of Prehistoria. The chest respawns after 7 days: a character that looted it before and still carries the Medallion or the Staff skips the step.

legs.name: revelosh
notes: Revelosh (6910, faction 59, hostile to both teams) drops The Shaft of Tsol (item 7741, 100%). The leader loots the corpse itself (boss.loot_item). The companions loot their kills too, and under round-robin or group loot the Shaft goes to whoever takes it first, so the boss has companions_loot false: the driver orders '.bot action loot off' before the pull and 'on' after the leader's loot. With the Shaft and the Gni'kiv Medallion from Baelog's Chest in the bags, the after_boss step uses the Medallion: its spell 9594 'Attach Medallion to Shaft' (2 s cast, reagent 7741) makes the Staff of Prehistoria (7733) that the Keystone's lock needs. A leader that carries the Staff already (a GM set it up) passes both. No quest is needed for the drop: the loot row has a positive chance and no condition, and no quest asks for the Shaft, the Medallion or the Staff. What hid the Shaft in live run 4 was the group loot: a white item below the uncommon threshold shows only to the member whose turn it was at the kill (a companion, which with its looting off never opened the corpse), so the driver switches the group to free_for_all for the leader's loot (README, boss.loot_item).

legs.name: keystone
notes: The Keystone's lock (359) needs the Staff of Prehistoria (item 7733) for a non-GM; without it the use is silently ignored (live run 3), so the step carries requires_item and the driver fails early, naming the item, when the leader's bags lack it. A GM passes the lock. The real game gives the staff through a quest.
Checked live on 2026-10-13 (docs/LIVE-CHECKS.md): use_object on the Keystone (124371) from 2.6 yd opened it; the Seal of Khaz'Mul (124372, 55 yd on) became active 27 s later, hence the 60 s wait.
The Stonevault Cave Lurkers (4850) spawn stealthed (aura 5916), so their groups are 'ambush': the party walks through them instead of pulling.

The Stonevault Ambushers (7175) of the room at y 215 are NOT stealthed and do not evade (world export: no aura in creature_template or creature_addon, movement_type 0, wander 0; second live run: 5 of the 6 died). They are six stationary spawns in two rows of three with no creature group, so a pull brings one or two; hence two pull groups (west, east; radius 10 yd so that each takes its own row, the rows being 14 yd apart) and a driver that counts a pull that killed something as progress.

legs.name: scorpid_cave
notes: Ironaya's room is a dead end. The way on goes back south through the Seal of Khaz'Mul (open since leg 2) and east through the cave at -205 265, 126 yd by the navmesh from Ironaya to the west lip of the mesh at -163.5 298.7 -52.5, where the Cleft Scorpid pit begins. The leg walks that with the navmesh and ends at the nest in the pit, the last thing before the hole in the mesh that leg 5 crosses. Packs on it: a Shrike Bat (4861, wander 3) at -186 285 and the nest of ten Cleft Scorpids (7078, level 35-36, wander 1, sleeping) at -175 to -165 / 284 to 296, z -53, which the route passes within 2.5 yd, so it is pulled. The live map walk of 2026-10-14 (~/TortoiseBots-audit/tests/uldaman-map/MAP.md) saw the same spawns at the same places.
Nothing is pulled from Ironaya's room: the first group of the leg is the bat. Stonevault Cave Lurkers (4850, stealth) near -250 270 are 25+ yd west of the route and left alone.

legs.name: sentinel
notes: Starts across the one hole of the map 70 navmesh, found by `path_to` and confirmed by the live map walk (MAP.md): the west part (entrance, legs 0-4) ends at the scorpid pit's lip (-163.5 298.7 -52.5), the east part (the rest of the dungeon) begins at -158.4 283.7 -48.9, and between them is a continuous ramp of 15 yd that the mesh does not link (a straight walk over it worked both ways for a GM walker; `walk_path` alone returns partial). hires-1 (2026-10-14, 12:41) showed that `cmd move` (a server navmesh path) to the east side is acked but the bots stop on the pit floor at -161.1 284.5 -52.1. So the leg crosses with a `via` list: the lip (a plain walk along the mesh), then two direct steps (`direct`: the driver sends `cmd move x y z direct`, TortoiseBots #942/#948): 4 yd to -162.8 294.8 -51.2, under the high side of the rock overhang the ramp starts under, then 12 yd up the ramp to -158.4 283.7 -48.9, the first point of the east mesh (the leg's `to`; the rest of the leg walks the east mesh from there). Why two: 3 to 5 yd south of the lip the overhang leaves only 1.5 to 2 yd above the floor on the line the GM walked, so one long step's 2 yd sight line hits its underside (runs 11 and 13 of hires-2: `no-los` for the lead bot at the lip, to -158.4 283.7 and to -160.5 291). Checked offline with the core's vmap code on the live map 70 vmap (lostool on the test VM, ~/tb-ci/vmaps70; TortoiseBots #948): both steps are clear at 1.5, 2 and 2.5 yd, both ways, from every floor point within 1 yd of each start, and the floor under each line has no step over 1 yd. The old plateau point -155.7 279.6 -46.8 is above a 2 yd step from the ramp top and out of sight from it: it is no direct target. The followers take the lead bot's line (TortoiseBots #948: each walks to the lead bot's spot first); an older module checks every bot's own line, and followers on the pit floor west of the lip, a 2.5 yd ledge below the ramp, fail it. The test TestUldamanDirectSteps pins the steps' lengths and the floor at the ends.

East of the hole: the Venomlash Scorpid (7022, wander 5) at -153 275, the second nest of ten Cleft Scorpids (7078) at -145 to -133 / 258 to 277, which stands 11.7 yd off the route and is pulled all the same because of its size, the Jadespine Basilisk (4863, Crystalline Slumber) at -141 312.5, then the Relic Hunter camp, one pull group of six: five Relic Hunters (4847) and a Geologist (7030) at -139.4 370.1, -151.8 368.5 (ledge, z -34), -160.9 364 (ledge, wanders 5), -137.3 386.4, -143.1 389 and -139.3 393.8. hires-3 (2026-10-14, trace r-20261014T163749-c696) showed the camp is one pack: the plan had a group for the first Hunter alone and a trio, the party killed the first Hunter in 26 s with the second ledge Hunter sheeped, then the engage loop picked the next Hunter of the same entry (the group radius reaches all of them) and that pull woke four Hunters, the Geologist and the Sentinel at once: six mobs and a wipe. The six are now one group (their world rows are in the export, and the 25 yd pack radius around any pull target holds the rest), so the pack CC counts them all.

Obsidian Sentinel (7023, level 42, 8255 hp, faction 54, EventAI) stands in a dead-end room at -163.8 388; the Echomok Door (124370, -185.4 389.6) is on its west side, between the room and the Back Entrance corridor, and is not on this route, so there is no door step (the earlier draft of this plan had one). The Sentinel re-casts Spell Reflection (9941, 'Obsidian Reflection') whenever the aura is missing (event type 27), so casters lose a spell now and then; at 80, 60, 40 and 20 % health it summons an Obsidian Shard (10061) and casts Splintered Obsidian (10072). The two ledge Relic Hunters at -160.9 364 and -151.8 368.5 stand 23-24 yd from it and join its fight; they are part of the camp group before it (no boss.first: the camp is cleared first, and the Sentinel, if it comes with a pull, is a joiner of that fight).

legs.name: ancient_stone_keeper
notes: From the Sentinel south-west through the big central hall (x -110 to -40, y 200 to 340): the Earthen guards of the hall (Earthen Rocksmashers 7011, Sculptors 7012, faction 415, hostile to both teams, stationary or wandering 2-5 yd) in five groups, two Stone Stewards (4860, waypoint patrols: their spawn point is where the plan looks first). Packs are the spawns within 10 yd of the navmesh route (the older legs use 8), grouped by tools/dungeongen (12 yd, creature groups).

Ancient Stone Keeper (7206, level 44, 8910 hp, faction 415, no script, one spell, 10132) stands alone at the south end of the central hall, a dead end off the way on: it is a mini boss, nothing opens behind it.

legs.name: galgann
notes: North out of the central hall's east side: Rocksmashers/Sculptors/a Steward, then the nest of ten Deadly Cleft Scorpids (7405, level 42-43, wander 1) 6.7 yd off the route at -21 331, then the two Shadowforge Sharpshooters (7290) at the foot of the ramp, then the two pairs of Darkcaster (4848) and Archaeologist (4849) that stand 10-12 yd off the approach to the Galgann room. The casters of the Shadowforge groups run at 15 % health (EventAI 'Flee at 15% HP'), so a wounded one can bring the next group.

Galgann Firehammer (7291, level 45, 13302 hp, faction 54, EventAI) stands with two Shadowforge Geologists (7030) in one creature group (leader guid 27491): the plan kills the Geologists first (boss.first). He yells on aggro and casts Amplify Flames (9482); his spell list is 3356, 8053 and 11969. Turtle-custom data: none found (the entries are untouched by the database updates read).

legs.name: grimlok
notes: Back out of the Galgann room and east along the Stonevault corridor: Brawler (4855) + Geomancer (4853) pairs and trios (Geomancers flee at 15 % health), the patrolling Brawler near 57.9 374, then the group of three at 55 417.

Grimlok (4854, level 45, 7390 hp, faction 59, EventAI) is in one creature group (leader guid 27528) with a Stonevault Brawler, a Stonevault Geomancer and a Jadespine Basilisk (4863; script mob_jadespine_basilisk: Crystalline Slumber every 28 s on its target, which it then drops from its threat): boss.first kills them in that order. Grimlok yells on aggro and on a player kill, casts Bloodlust (6742) at 30 % health, and has the spells 11892, 8292, 8143 and 9532. The run's `cc` option can mark the Basilisk.

legs.name: keepers_door
notes: Back along the corridor Grimlok's room opens into, then south down the Stonevault passage and the ramp room of the Stonevault Maulers (7320) and Flameweavers (7321; Fire Shield IV, flee at 15 %; Maulers frenzy at 50 %) to the foot of the ramp up to the Hall of the Keepers (z -26). The route is 260 yd; the packs of the way in (the trio at 55 417 and the three near 58 374) were pulled by the grimlok leg.

The Temple Door (124368, 50.0 247.2 -26.5) closes the Hall of the Keepers: a plain door like the Echomok Door (type 0, lock 86, spawned closed, no script; same unverified lock). The step uses it from the west side (46.5 247.2).

legs.name: keepers_altar
notes: The Hall of the Keepers (z -26.5) is a large room with three squads of Earthen guards (four Stonebreakers 7396, a Stonecarver 7397 and a Stone Steward 4860 each, faction 415, level 44-45, wander 2): west of the altar on the route (73-89 / 251-269), east (112-130 / 244-264) and north (88-108 / 292-301), both 22 yd from the altar. All three are pulled BEFORE the ritual (radius 31 around the route, not the 10 of the other legs), because the Stone Keepers that the ritual wakes fight in the middle of the room and the squads would join. Four Stone Keepers (4857, faction 35, stoned) stand around the altar at 91-118 / 259-286 and are left alone until the altar.

Altar of the Keepers (130511, 104.8 272.5 -26.5) is a summoning ritual (game object type 18) with three participants: gameobject_template data0 3, spell 11568, animation spell 11206, ritualPersistent 1, castersGrouped 1. GameObject::Use counts the different players of the first user's group that used it; each stands channelling the animation, a user who moves is taken out of the count; with the third the ritual spell sends the scripted event 2228 (event_awaken_stone_keeper), which wakes the first Stone Keeper. One bot using it is not enough: the ritual step orders cmd ritual for three bots, which walk to the altar, use it in turn and stand still until it is active and the ritual spell (5 s) has run; its final answer is the step's result. The altar itself reads ready again once the bots are let go (their movement ends the channel), so the plan does not wait for it to be active: the next leg waits for the door the Keepers' death opens. Core, read from GameObject::Use: the use that brings the count to three makes the object active and casts the spell, a participant that moves is taken out of the count again.

legs.name: keepers
notes: The Stone Keepers (4857, level 46, 5757 hp, EventAI, one spell: Trample 5568) wake one at a time (instance_uldaman.cpp, SetData STONE_KEEPERS IN_PROGRESS): the first one that is alive and not awake attacks the nearest player within 80 yd; when it dies it casts Self Destruct (9874) and wakes the next; when the fourth is dead the encounter is DONE and the Temple Door 124367 opens. A Stone Keeper that evades (no target: a wipe, everybody dead or out of range) sets the encounter to FAIL and all four stand up stoned again. Which one wakes first is the order the instance script saw the creatures in, not known from the data, hence one group of four with radius 30.

The group is pulled as the Keepers wake (hostile in the feed); the leg's only gate is the wait for the door 124367 (137.7 288.1 -26.4) to be active, with the plan's longest ceiling (600 s): four 5757 hp mobs one after the other are a few minutes for a party that can fight. The Stone Keepers are friendly (faction 35) until woken, so a group of them is never in the feed before the ritual; `dungeongen -check` warns about them as friends unless `-awakened 4857,2748` says they are woken by script. After a FAIL the Altar of the Keepers keeps its active state (nothing in the world data or the scripts resets it with DATA_KEEPERS_ALTAR), so a second try would need a new instance: unverified, read from the code only.

legs.name: descent
notes: Out through the Temple Door 124367 (open now) and down the long ramp that runs round the east side of the hall and the Vault: the squad east of the door (144-154 / 288-306), the patrolling Stone Steward at 165.6 261.4, the squad at the bend (118-132 / 220-230, z -42), the Steward patrol at 76 214 (z -55) and, in the room in front of Archaedas' door, the squad of seven (four Stonebreakers, two Stonecarvers, a Steward at 48-65 / 238-261, z -52). The two Vault Warders (10120) at 48.5 251.1 and 52 243.8 in that room are statues (faction 35, stoned) that Archaedas' script despawns at 33 % health; the plan leaves them.
The way from the Keepers' hall to Archaedas is only this ramp: the navmesh has no other link between the Hall and the Vault level, and the ramp starts at the door 124367.

legs.name: archaedas
notes: The Temple Door 141869 (70.7 256.9 -52.1, plain door, lock 86 like the other two) is the way into the Vault. Archaedas' script shuts it when the fight starts (DoResetDoor, no-interact) and opens it again on his death or a reset.

Altar of Archaedas (133234, 96.5 269.1 -52.1): a summoning ritual like the Altar of the Keepers (three participants, spell 10340, animation 11206, scripted event 2268 event_awaken_archaedas). The ritual step has three bots use it in turn, as at the Keepers' altar; Archaedas waking and appearing in the feed is what the boss part waits for. The comment in boss_archaedas.cpp says one click is enough since 3.0.8; the Turtle gameobject_template still says three.

Archaedas (2748, level 47, 29850 hp, boss_archaedas) spawns stoned at 104.3 272.3 -51.7 and awakens 4 s after the ritual; he attacks the nearest player within 80 yd. Every 10 s one more stoned wall minion wakes (Earthen Custodians 7309 and Hallshapers 7077 along the walls: the Custodians cast Reconstruct (10260) on him below 50 % health); at 66 % he wakes the six Earthen Guardians (7076); at 33 % the two Vault Warders of the room (10120: Trample, 7392 hp) and the furniture pair despawns; Ground Tremor (6524) first after 60 s, then every 45 s. He evades when he or his target is more than 38 yd from his spawn point (the door at 70.7 256.9 is 37.0 yd from it, the stand point in front of it 39.0): keep the party at the altar side of the Vault, the stand point of the altar step is 11 yd from him. On a reset the door opens and everything stands up stoned again; the altar stays active (unverified, see the Keepers).

On his death the instance script despawns every minion that is left, so `skip` lists the adds (7076, 7077, 7309, 10120) and the leg waits only for the Vault door 124369 (137.7 288.1 -52.1), which opens at once. Behind it: Lore Keeper of Norgannon (7172, 147.6 311.1), The Discs of Norgannon (131474, 161.8 298.3) and the Turtle-custom Ancient Treasure Chest (2010828, 167.7 287.4, loot item 60195 at 100 %, respawn 5 s); the plan does not loot them.
